nom: CHANEL LE TONIQUE Anti-Pollution Invigorating Toner

avis.texte: First time using this toner and it has become my favorite toner . It feels smooth and hydrating to your skin leaving your skin looking quenched. Love this

avis.titre: Exactly what I ordered! Very pleased.
avis.texte: I have used this Chanel product for many years. As I run out, I always reorder. Amazon did a good job in packaging; not crushed or damaged at all.

avis.titre: The best toner for my face by Chanel thus far❣️
avis.texte: This is to me the best toner I have used by Chanel and the smaller size bottle is perfect for travel! I love ❤️ this❣️

avis.titre: Can be a beautiful giftCan be a beautiful gift
avis.texte: Like it very much! The only thing that I personally didn’t like was the Amazon label that was stuck in the front of the product box. If purchased for a present can be a problem. Apart from that- beautiful, original, looks expensive. A lot of it for the price.
